requirements.sourceQuote: A prerequisite for admission to the Master's course of study is proof of a degree in an economics, business, management or finance course of study (210 ECTS) at a university of applied sciences, a university or a similar institution of higher education.

A prerequisite for admission to the Master's course of study is proof of a degree in an economics, business, management or finance course of study (210 ECTS) at a university of applied sciences, a university or a similar institution of higher education.
The course of study must include at least six semesters of theory.
Professional competence must be verified by relevant professional knowledge and competences.
The admission commission can base its decision on a selective conversation and may integrate the professional suitability when making its decision.
